raw.os: Windows Vista or newer (32 or 64 bit)
raw.processor: Intel Core i5 660 CPU or equivalent
raw.sound card: DirectX-compatible sound card or onboard audio chip
raw.additional notes: 1) Supports Keyboard+Mouse and XInput/DirectInput devices including Xbox 360, Xbox One, DualShock4 and Steam Controller. 2) Some high end integrated graphics chips and modern gaming laptops with a discrete GPU may work but have not been tested, nor are they officially supported by Capcom.
